question: Can acquisition, probe selection, coverage tracking and numerical coefficient writes run as fixed threshold/synaptic state transitions, rather than an external task-dependent discovery compiler?
hypothesis: A fixed general threshold machine can incrementally compute certified Boolean polynomial coefficients from actual replies, acquire linear/quadratic operators from their complete low-degree subcubes, and recover arbitrary operators only after sufficient information. Missing high-order evidence must preserve errors, not fictitious inference.
world: Unknown width-bit output map for each of2 actions. Linear has random bias and4 distinct linear inputs/output (at width4 all4). Quadratic adds4 distinct pair-input monomials with random nonzero output vector; cubic adds4 degree3 terms instead. Arbitrary_hash generates deterministic unstructured full output vectors. Learner receives only width, actual numeric x/y replies and preprogrammed local arithmetic; never family/seed/source.
numeric_machine: Fixed bit arrays for observed truth weights, seen bits, partial ANF coefficient weights, subset-coverage counts and fault telemetry. All observations are decoded by fixed signed-weight threshold matches over every state; selected old reply read by dot products. Numeric delta-XOR toggles each coefficient whose mask contains the observed input; coverage counts increment only for newly seen inputs. Coefficients become active only when every submask has been observed, using numeric threshold gates. Data-dependent Python candidate search/dictionary/min/sort is absent from learning updates. Fixed loops are generic simulation. All probe choices come from numeric first-missing winner gates over a prewired degree-then-state address order. Output parity uses threshold gates; source adapter just packs chosen numeric address. This is a programmed learning algorithm, not autonomous algorithm invention.
capacity: Each action resident truth2**n*n bits, partial coefficients2**n*n bits, seen2**n bits, subset counts2**n bounded integers, fault bit. Certified coefficient bits derived, fixed readout mask weights/prewired order static. Include all storage and checkpoint bytes; fixed feature family preallocated, no dynamic capacity.
phases_spec: Observe exactly every state of degree<=1, then<=2, then all states, using numeric query policy. Score each phase on32 sampled-with-replacement unseen inputs/action where any remain; full phase uses exhaustive all-state replay and must never be called unseen generalization. Evaluate24 unseen action sequences of length2..4/phase and4 depth3 goals using learned maps. Full-phase compositions can reuse seen primitive inputs but have untrained action sequences.
controls: independent external exact Boolean Mobius/compiler from identical replies with same zero-for-unobserved coefficient prior; must tie
fully fitted conventional one-hot least-squares lookup from same replies (unique observed one-hot coefficients take target, unseen zero; global minimum training error0)
counterexample: cubic/hash scores preserved at early phases
trained_control: Closed-form fully fitted conventional one-hot linear regression, outputs per observed source address. Explicitly different feature prior; its unseen scores cannot establish superiority to strongest trained neural model.

tests.repair: after full acquisition flip one actual input/action/output bit in source, observe exactly that real replacement once; all updated coefficients and all full replay must match external independent compilation; other action and second world unchanged
tests.incremental_certificate: all activated coefficients equal true full-source coefficients for linear/quadratic/cubic teacher; only when all submasks observed; hash full certificate validated by independent exhaustive coefficients

thresholds.engineering: full final inherited regression,new tests,source atlas,clean tree Windows/Linux; identical integer scores/trace and numeric/external coefficient/readout parity
thresholds.positive: all linear linear-basis and quadratic quadratic-basis unseen predictions/compositions/goals exact; all full maps and one-observation point repairs exact; zero disabled-learning information gain
thresholds.negative: cubic/hash early stages must have nonzero failures, report every world and stage; full-truth replay is not generalization
thresholds.science: DEV_SUPPORTED only for preset bounded numeric-internalization and negatives. No independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS or general intelligence; all rules, learning arithmetic and representation family remain supplied.

authority: Isolated bounded public synthetic contributor draft/hosted CI. No merge/main/accepted refs, official loop, private runner, protected first-use, controller,scheduler,paid API,integration,deployment or live action.
limits: The exact general threshold/synaptic learning procedure and finite Boolean feature basis are programmed.
Unknown facts still require source observations. No prior-free or evidence-free knowledge.
This does not port all ofWSP44 adaptive randomized discovery into neurons; it first isolates internal exact acquisition/selection/certification arithmetic.
Python remains the generic numerical simulator/validation/IO, not absent software.
